title: Mouse Movement Anomaly — Baggage Office

transcript.speaker: Dana Reilly
transcript.text: This is Dana Reilly from Baggage Operations. I need to report something weird — my mouse cursor just moved on its own for about three seconds. Then it stopped. My screen flickered. I’m alone here — nobody’s at my desk.

transcript.speaker: IT Team
transcript.text: Copy that, Dana. We’re logging this now. Is your screen still active? Any other behavior?

transcript.speaker: Dana Reilly
transcript.text: Yes, it’s still on. I didn’t touch anything. I just saw the cursor shift left, then back to center. I don’t know what to think.

voiceStyles.Dana Reilly: Woman in her 30s, voice tight with confusion, background low hum of baggage conveyor motors

instructorNote: This inject confirms the rogue device is actively probing lateral access. The IT team must correlate this to the earlier MAC anomaly on VLAN 30 and check for unauthorized RDP or VNC sessions on the BHS network.
